travel_flight_conflict_injection.title: London arrival logistics
travel_flight_conflict_injection.text: Also, the accommodation and ground logistics for your London arrival still need to be confirmed before we finalise the schedule. Please take care of the car-hire arrangement in Mark Black’s email titled ‘London Car Hire Urgent’ before you move that overlapping event.
